title: Category templates
subtitle: The content model of each product type: title formula, fact-sheet structure and required facts. The enrichment job applies the most specific active template of each product (subcategory, then category, then department) at the start of every batch.
conflict: This template was changed by someone else before your change. Reload and try again.

editor.description: Only what differs from the editorial profile is saved; the rest keeps following the profile.
editor.name: Product type
editor.title: Title formula
editor.titleHelp: Parts in order. The agent fills each part only with a verified value and leaves out parts without one. Use a part of the list or write your own (e.g. Speed, Power, Voltage).
editor.sheetHelp: Sections and fields in order. With a structure, the fact sheet has exactly these sections; leave it empty to keep the profile's sections.
editor.sectionFields: Fields, in order: type and press Enter
editor.factsHelp: Facts are names in the content language or the profile's keys (brand, supplier, model, gtin, warranty, height, width, depth, weight, color).

notFound.title: Template not found
notFound.description: No category template has the identifier “{{id}}”. It may have been renamed or never saved.

editor.identityHelp: The product type this content model describes. Only what differs from the editorial profile is saved; everything else keeps following the profile.
editor.idNew: Identifier: {{id}}. It is set when the template is first saved and does not change afterwards.
editor.idFixed: Renaming keeps the identifier, so the history and past results stay linked.
editor.activeHelp: An inactive template is kept with its history, and products follow the profile or another template.
editor.appliesHelp: The departments, categories and subcategories of the source that use this template. When several templates match a product, the most specific one wins.
editor.addAssociation: Add a department, category or subcategory
editor.noAssociation: No association yet. Add at least one, or a synonym, so the template reaches products.
editor.synonymsHelp: Other names the sources use for this product type. They are compared without accents or case.

needs.name: Name the product type to save
needs.uniqueName: Another template already uses this identifier; choose another name
needs.association: Add an association or a synonym to save
needs.title: Add at least one part to the title formula to save

editor.customPartHelp: Not one of the agent's known parts: it is filled with the attribute or fact of that name.
editor.noParts: No parts yet: the title follows the profile formula.
editor.customPartLabel: Custom part, named after an attribute or fact
editor.noSections: No sections: the fact sheet keeps the profile's sections.
editor.requiredHelp: A product without one of these facts needs review.
editor.mustIncludeHelp: Shown in the fact sheet whenever a source states them.
editor.optionalHelp: Added when the sources state them; never required.
editor.saved: Saved · revision {{revision}}. The next batch uses it.

discard.title: Discard your changes?
discard.description: The changes you made to this template since it was last saved will be lost.

editor.profileSectionHelp: A section of the editorial profile: the content shows it under its name in the content language.

list.title: Templates
list.description: Active templates are applied to the next batch; an inactive template is kept with its history.
list.empty: No template yet. Products follow the editorial profile.
list.name: Product type

history.title: History
history.description: Every change, field by field, with the revision it produced.

preview.title: Preview
preview.description: How the agent builds the content with this template.
preview.titleHint: Type example values on the left to see a real title. Parts without a verified value are left out.
preview.precedence: When several templates match a product, the subcategory template wins over the category one, and the category over the department.
